question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
WITH first_payment_per_customer AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) AS first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
first_payment_rental AS (
    SELECT 
        fpc.customer_id,
        p.rental_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fpc.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_id) AS rn
    FROM first_payment_per_customer fpc
    JOIN payment p ON fpc.customer_id = p.customer_id 
        AND fpc.first_payment_date = p.payment_date
),
first_rentals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, rental_id
    FROM first_payment_rental
    WHERE rn = 1
),
first_movie_rating AS (
    SELECT 
        fr.customer_id,
        f.rating
    FROM first_rentals fr
    JOIN rental r ON fr.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.rental_id) AS total_rentals
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    fmr.rating,
    ROUND(AVG(1.0 * ct.total_amount), 2) AS avg_total_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(1.0 * (ct.total_rentals - 1)), 2) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_movie_rating fmr
JOIN customer_totals ct ON fmr.customer_id = ct.customer_id
GROUP BY fmr.rating
ORDER BY fmr.rating;
